title: Capitals of Eastern Asia
intro: 5 capital cities of Eastern Asia, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Pyongyang
rounds.fact: Pyongyang is the capital of Democratic People's Republic of Korea.

rounds.name: Beijing
rounds.fact: Beijing is the capital of China.

rounds.name: Seoul
rounds.fact: Seoul is the capital of Republic of Korea.

rounds.name: Tokyo
rounds.fact: Tokyo is the capital of Japan.

rounds.name: Ulaanbaatar
rounds.fact: Ulaanbaatar is the capital of Mongolia.
